business_problem: Harbin Zhaolin Middle School wanted to bring AI into everyday teaching and campus practice, but most teachers lacked AI knowledge, suitable classroom tools, and a workable method to connect emerging technology with lesson delivery, student engagement, and school management.
solution_summary: Harbin Zhaolin Middle School partnered with Baidu Education to deploy an AI Innovation Lab that combines curriculum resources, a teaching platform, hands-on training projects, and immersive experiences in one smart-classroom environment. The implementation is based on Baidu's Artificial Intelligence Education Solution and Industry-Education Integration Solution, which package AI, robotics, big data, IoT, and brain-science technologies into an environment that supports classroom teaching, STEAM education, and teacher capability training. The school uses an online AI teaching-resource platform together with offline hardware teaching aids, AI classroom tools, smart speakers, and AR experience devices so teachers can learn the technology and then apply it directly in English, biology, and other classes.

solution_components.name: Artificial Intelligence Education Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the smart-education framework used for AI teaching, teacher training, and classroom integration.

solution_components.name: Industry-Education Integration Solution
solution_components.role: Packages curriculum, training projects, and applied teaching workflows for school AI programs.

solution_components.name: Baidu Education AI Innovation Lab
solution_components.role: Acts as the physical and digital teaching environment that combines online resources with offline devices and practical labs.

data_flow: Baidu's online teaching resources, lesson materials, and training content are delivered through the AI Innovation Lab, where teachers use the platform and connected classroom devices to prepare lessons, run AI-enabled classroom activities, and give students hands-on exposure to smart technologies.
business_outcome: The school raised teacher AI readiness, improved lesson-preparation efficiency, and made AI classes far more interactive, giving students richer exposure to applied technology across multiple subjects.
metrics: Information-technology teacher training pass rate reached 100%.
Overall teacher AI capability training pass rate reached 75%.
architecture_clues: The lab combines online resource delivery with offline soft-hardware practice
The same environment supports AI teaching, STEAM education, and new-technology teacher training
Classroom examples include XiaoDu-based spoken-English practice and AR-based biology visualization
evidence_quotes: After the AI Innovation Lab was built, teacher AI teaching ability and AI technology application ability improved through several rounds of training (original: 哈尔滨兆麟中学的百度教育 AI 创新实验室建成之后，通过几次新技术能力培训，提升了教师的人工智能教学能力及人工智能技术的应用能力).

The solution integrates AI, robotics, big data, IoT, and brain science with curriculum resources, a teaching platform, training projects, and virtual experience (original: 这是将基于人工智能、机器人、大数据、物联网、脑科学等新兴技术整合起来，集课程资源、教学平台、实训项目和虚拟体验为一体的智慧教育解决方案).
Teachers used Baidu's AI teaching platform, hardware teaching aids, and curriculum system to run AI classes (original: 教师也熟悉掌握了利用百度提供的 AI 教学平台、配套硬件教具及课程体系开展人工智能课程).

Metrics included 75% overall teacher pass rate, 100% information-technology teacher pass rate, 40% higher lesson-preparation efficiency, and 90% higher student participation (original: 教师 AI 能力培训考核通过率达到 75%，信息技术教师考核通过率达 100% / 40% 备课效率提升 / +90% 学生参与度).
